stone.nirncraft.warrior.desc: Combat skills (One-Handed, Two-Handed, Archery, Block, Heavy Armor, Smithing) improve 20% faster.
stone.nirncraft.mage.desc: Magic skills (Destruction, Restoration, Alteration, Conjuration, Illusion, Enchanting) improve 20% faster.
stone.nirncraft.thief.desc: Stealth skills (Light Armor, Sneak, Lockpicking, Pickpocket, Speech, Alchemy) improve 20% faster.
stone.nirncraft.lord.desc: Your skin hardens like armor (+4 armor) and you resist 25% of magic.
stone.nirncraft.atronach.desc: +50 Magicka and you absorb 30% of hostile magic, but Magicka regenerates 50% slower.
stone.nirncraft.apprentice.desc: Magicka regenerates twice as fast, but you take 50% more damage from magic.
stone.nirncraft.ritual.desc: Once a day, call two dead thralls up from the earth to fight for you for a minute.
stone.nirncraft.serpent.desc: Once a day, paralyze and poison the creature you are looking at.
stone.nirncraft.shadow.desc: Once a day, fade from sight for a minute.
stone.nirncraft.steed.desc: +100 carry weight, worn armor no longer slows you and you move 5% faster.
stone.nirncraft.tower.desc: Once a day, the next lock you try opens by itself.
